Chapter 990: Chapter 7: The Structure of the Inner Universe (Please Subscribe)_2

This means that the Thirteenth-Order Temporal being believes that anyone who comprehends all the runes within a Cosmic Era is qualified to completely control this jade gourd.

“These runes…”

After a moment of contemplation, Lin Yuan looked at the more than three thousand runes floating in the heaven and earth.

Each rune was the size of a fist, but vaguely, it seemed like a universe unto itself.

“One rune is equal to one universe?” Lin Yuan let out a breath of relief.

Doesn’t that mean that three thousand three hundred and thirty-three runes are equivalent to three thousand three hundred and thirty-three universes, equivalent to three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Chaos Venerables?

“Not exactly one universe…” Lin Yuan carefully observed, his gaze continuously sweeping over each rune.

Each rune represents the unique structure of a certain universe, and strictly speaking, the three thousand three hundred and thirty-three runes explicate three thousand three hundred and thirty-three types of cosmic structures.

The essence of the Origin Source in the universe is the same, but the structures differ, the microcosmic arrangements differ, and the universes that are ultimately formed are also completely different.

Just like the basic element carbon, different ways of structuring carbon can lead to vastly different substances like diamond and coal.

It is the same with universes.

“Universes also have so many ways of structuring?” Lin Yuan gazed at the three thousand three hundred and thirty-three runes, astounded in his heart.

No matter which type of structure, the universe that is finally formed is far superior to the home universe where Lin Yuan resides.

“Why are you not hasting to comprehend the first rune, what are you hesitating for?” A childish voice came through, only to see a red-dressed girl with jejune features and two sky-piercing braids appeared not far away, looking at Lin Yuan with boredom and reminded him.

“Who are you?”

Lin Yuan looked at the red-dressed girl.

Compared to the figure that condensed earlier, the red-dressed girl was more like a living being; that figure was clearly just an image, without the slightest consciousness.

“Who am I?”

“If you can pass the test, you are my master, and I will assist you in cultivating the inheritance left by my old master.”

The red-dressed girl rolled her eyes, “You don’t think that you alone, without any guidance, can cultivate the inheritance left by the old master, do you?”

“So that’s how it is.” Lin Yuan suddenly understood.

The red-dressed girl should be similar to a ‘teacher’ role, prepared by the being who left behind the jade gourd for those who come after, to guide them on how to cultivate the inheritance within the jade gourd.

“How great was my old master, even the foundational inheritance he left behind is as difficult to cultivate as ascending to the heavens, and without me by your side to give pointers, there’s even less hope.”

The red-dressed girl stood with her chest puffed out, speaking proudly.

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Indeed, this was the case.

Many inheritances of human civilization also come with a vast array of guidance; to cultivate on one’s own would make it difficult to achieve anything significant.

“It’s good that you understand my importance.” The red-dressed girl continued, “These three thousand three hundred and thirty-three runes represent three thousand three hundred and thirty-three different cosmic structural laws.”

“As for the use…”

The red-dressed girl said, “It’s to integrate them into your inner cosmos, to allow your inner cosmos to possess all the advantages of these three thousand three hundred and thirty-three cosmic structural laws.”

The red-dressed girl explained.

“Inner cosmos.” Lin Yuan also thought of this point.

An inner cosmos of the same size and area, its quality is determined by the cosmic structure.

The more perfect the cosmic structure, the more profound the foundation of the inner cosmos, which is the strongest foundation of a Twelfth-Order life.

Of course, each method of inner cosmic structure is incredibly complex, and the difficulty of fully comprehending them is imaginable.

The cosmos is vast and limitless, and so are the methods of construction within it; this is precisely why the time limit given by the owner of the jade gourd is a Cosmic Era.

“If I can comprehend these three thousand three hundred and thirty-three cosmic structural laws and then integrate them into my inner cosmos, what level will my inner cosmos reach?”

Lin Yuan suddenly had a thought and asked.

“Comprehend the three thousand three hundred and thirty-three cosmic structural laws?” The red-dressed girl blinked, “You haven’t even begun, and you’re already thinking about what happens after comprehension?”

“However, if you truly can do so, your inner cosmos will probably be close to the level of a normal Chaos Realm’s inner cosmos, right?”

The red-dressed girl thought for a moment, then explained nonetheless.

She too hoped that Lin Yuan could comprehend all the runes within a Cosmic Era, meaning she could also gain a certain degree of freedom, without having to be trapped inside the jade gourd for long, endless cosmic eras.

“An inner cosmos close to a normal Chaos Realm?” Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

A universe within the body of a normal Chaos Venerable? It meant that Lin Yuan could withstand the surge of power during the cosmic catastrophe, and if that were true, he alone could carry most of human civilization through the cosmic disaster.

“For now, you should stop thinking too much and strive to comprehend all the runes within one Cosmic Era.” The girl in red reminded him again.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

…

Cosmic Starry Skies.

Lin Yuan revealed his figure.

A palace the size of a fist appeared before him.

It was the ultimate defense palace activated by the Yu Clan Ultimate, at the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm.

Inside, it suppressed dozens of Twelve-Stage Ultimates from this universe.

“The cosmic catastrophe is imminent, and there’s no need to continue this stalemate with these Twelve-Stage Ultimates.”

Lin Yuan looked at the imposing palace.

According to Lin Yuan’s original plan, he intended to continue suppressing the dozens of ultimates inside the palace until he stepped into the Chaos Realm, reaching the level of a Chaos Great Saint.

Then, resolve them all together.

His home universe was still far from a normal cosmic catastrophe.

With Lin Yuan’s speed of cultivation, he was quite confident in becoming a Chaos Venerable before the arrival of the cosmic catastrophe, although not daring to claim he would become a Chaos Great Saint.

But the fight between two Chaos Great Saints caused the cosmic catastrophe to arrive ahead of time.

Under such circumstances, Lin Yuan faced two choices regarding the dozens of Twelve-Stage Ultimates inside the palace.

One was to continue ignoring them until the cosmic catastrophe came, then casually throw the palace into the depths of the universe, allowing the dozens of Twelve-Stage Ultimates to perish with the universe.

But this choice seemed slightly wasteful.

At the very least, the palace itself at the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm, as well as the many weapons, treasures, and rarities of the dozens of Twelve-Stage Ultimates inside, would be lost.

Thus, the second choice emerged.

Lin Yuan planned to release the dozens of Twelve-Stage Ultimates, providing that they surrender all their weapons, treasures, and rarities, along with the treasury and the ultimate defense palace at the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm.

This choice equated to maximizing benefits.

As for any potential threats from the released Twelve-Stage Ultimates… with Lin Yuan’s current strength, any avatar he casually condensed would possess the true might of the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm. Thus, even if these Twelve-Stage Ultimates were released, they would only quiver in hiding in corners.

Rustling.

With a subtle thought from Lin Yuan, the seal on the palace in front of him slightly faded.

“Galaxy’s mightiest, we are willing to surrender ninety percent of our weapons, treasures, and rarities, just to ask for your mercy in letting us out,” one voice said.

“Yes, Galaxy’s mightiest, as long as you release us, I am willing to submit to human civilization,” another offered.

“Indeed, Galaxy’s mightiest, we were wrong,” a third admitted.

…

From inside the palace, the pleas of dozens of Twelve-Stage Ultimates could be heard.

They were truly scared, worried that Lin Yuan would wait for the cosmic catastrophe to come and throw the palace that suppressed all the Twelve-Stage existences into the depths of the universe.

In such a case, all the Twelve-Stage beings would die; who could withstand the successive rounds of destruction brought by the cosmic disaster?

“Want to get out? I can let you go,” Lin Yuan said.

Lin Yuan looked toward the dozens of Twelve-Stage inside the palace, who at this moment posed no threat to him whatsoever.

If not for the universe’s own suppression, even the palace’s defense at the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm could not withstand Lin Yuan’s murderous intent.

“You can let us out?”

Upon hearing these words, all of the Twelve-Stage Ultimates were somewhat stupefied.

“But you have to hand over all the Twelve-Stage weapons, treasures, and rarities,” Lin Yuan stated.

“I am willing.”

“I am willing.”

“I am willing, too.”

Inside the palace, many Twelve-Stage Ultimates agreed without a second thought, without any hesitation.
